name: dental_crm
description: AI CRM for dentists — a typical vertical SaaS pitch.
pitch_summary: We are building an AI-powered CRM platform specifically designed for dental practices. Our system uses natural language processing to automatically transcribe and categorize patient interactions, schedule appointments based on treatment urgency, and predict patient lifetime value. We charge $299/month per practice and have 23 paying customers in our beta, with $8.4k MRR growing 18% month-over-month.
